sanskrit_verse: ṛtvigādir niyuktas tu samau saṃparikīrtitau / yajñe svāmy āpnuyāt puṇyaṃ hāniṃ vāde 'tha vā jayaṃ //
transliteration: ṛtvigādiḥ niyuktaḥ tu samau saṃparikīrtitau / yajñe svāmy āpnuyāt puṇyaṃ hāniṃ vāde 'tha vā jayaṃ //
sph_interpretive_translation: One appointed as a ritual conductor or designated authority, when equally proclaimed, shall acquire merit or loss in sacrifice; likewise, in debate or contest, victory follows rightful alignment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from conscious designation and public acknowledgment
Merit and demerit arise through alignment with dharma, not intention alone
Responsibility is commensurate with capacity and role acceptance
Truth prevails where roles are clearly defined and executed
Consciousness alignment determines outcome more than external effort
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A is publicly designated for role R AND performs within scope S THEN outcome O accrues to principal P
IF two parties claim equal authority THEN resolution depends on prior attestation and alignment with governing dharma
IF dispute arises in execution domain D THEN refer to attested role definitions and causal alignment
IF agent demonstrates capacity C for function F THEN assign responsibility R accordingly without punitive framing
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes over ceremonial or executive authority, the Supreme Court must prioritize attested designation and functional alignment over subjective claims. Merit or liability accrues based on lawful engagement, not personal motive.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that outcomes stem from rightful appointment and execution. There is no inherent fault in failure; misalignment invites correction, not punishment. Sequential manifestation shows how designation leads to consequence naturally, without imposed penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Realign designation records and reaffirm attested roles
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Confirm individual readiness and conscious acceptance before assigning authority
Capacity Restoration: Provide training or support where designation was premature
Integrity Reintegration: Publicly acknowledge correct role performance to restore energetic balance
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows through attuned designation and conscious execution. All outcomes reflect alignment, never judgment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
